title: Approve payment
loading: Loading the payment from the server

notFound.title: Payment not found
notFound.body: This link does not match a payment on the server. Ask the merchant for a new approval link.

loadError.title: The payment could not be loaded
loadError.body: The server answered with an error. Nothing has been approved or paid from this page.

fixture: Fixture data. Not connected to the server.

disconnected.title: Disconnected
disconnected.body: Showing the last state the server confirmed. Nothing on this screen is newer than that.
disconnected.never: The server has not been reached yet. No payment state is confirmed.
disconnected.actions: Approve and Decline are off until the connection returns.

card.displayNameNote: The name is supplied by the merchant and not verified. This identifier is what is enforced.
card.oneUseValue: One payment only. Cannot be used twice.
card.scopeValue: This payment only. No continuing permission remains afterwards.

pairing.checking: Checking that this phone is paired
pairing.unpairedBody: Approval needs a valid pairing link opened on this device. The link is missing, invalid or expired, so this page can only show the payment. Ask for a new pairing link or QR code.

action.failed: The server did not accept that action
action.expiredLocal: The expiry time has passed. Waiting for the server to confirm.

status.awaiting_approval: Check every detail. Nothing is paid until you approve.
status.approved: You approved these exact terms. The payment has not been executed yet.
status.executing: The payment is being executed. It is not complete yet.
status.rejected: An attempt did not match what you approved and was stopped.
status.expired: The approval window closed. Nothing can be paid with this approval.
status.failed: Execution failed. The evidence below shows what the rail recorded.

stopped.title: Why it was stopped
stopped.noDiffs: No field differences were reported for this attempt.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.noEvidence: No execution evidence has been recorded yet.
receipt.noReceipt: No receipt: nothing was executed for this attempt
